text: Question form with labelled textarea, character count, examples, submit validation, loading and error feedback.
Ordered execution timeline list with progress rows, current status and empty, partial, failed and populated states.
Answer text and citation cards list with empty, streaming, abstained, failed and complete states; long exact quotations wrap.
Cancel and reconnect buttons with visible labels, pending state, disabled states and actionable connection errors.
Page title, course context, status text and optional expandable run details with bounded long identifiers.
